codes.OBVIOUS: Expected correct above about 95% for adults; nothing learned.
codes.MISCALIBRATED: The difficulty label disagrees with the expected correct rate (see suggestedDifficulty).
codes.WEAK-DISTRACTORS: Wrong options that tempt nobody (jokes, made-up terms).
codes.PATTERNED-OPTIONS: Option values follow a pattern that reveals the answer.
codes.LENGTH-TELL: The answer stands out by its length.
codes.DUPLICATE: Same fact or prompt as another item (named in the note).
codes.DUPLICATE-ANSWER: Shares an answer with another item; never schedule both in one night.
codes.DISPUTED: The answer is contested or is a range.
codes.NEEDS-QUALIFIER: Needs a date, convention or source in the wording.
codes.AMBIGUOUS-WORDING: Can be read more than one way, or is too long to read in time.
codes.WRONG-GAME: Belongs to another game (usually Math Mayhem).
codes.COMPUTABLE: Has an exact arithmetic answer, so Closest Wins becomes a tie.
codes.INPUT-RANGE: The correct answer can't be entered with today's input.
codes.OBSCURE-UNINTERESTING: Hard only because it is niche, with no payoff.
codes.FLAT-REVEAL: Correct but the reveal teaches nothing; add one.
codes.CULTURAL-CONCENTRATION: Assumes one country's knowledge or vocabulary.
codes.ARBITRARY-ANSWER: Nothing in the item determines the answer.
codes.WRONG-GROUPING: A Connections group label or membership is loose.
codes.LIST-GAPS: The Category Sprint list rejects common valid answers.
codes.UNBOUNDED: The Category Sprint category has no complete answer list.
codes.SUBJECTIVE: Membership is a matter of opinion.
codes.SAMENESS: Quantity hiding a lack of variety.
codes.CLICHE: The prompt already contains the joke.
codes.HARD-TO-WRITE: Hard to write a good caption for.
codes.MISLABELLED-MODE: The geography mode doesn't match the item.
codes.ALTERNATIVE-SOLUTION: A Connections board with more than one valid partition (added automatically by the solver).
